_readme: S14R-0002 tunable constants, calibrated from the 14-burst S14R corpora (runs/daemon/runs/{s14r-0000-16h16,s14r-0000-17h43,s14r-and-r2..r5,s14r-ios-r1..r7}); see reports/s14r-0002-*.md for the A/B evidence. Page + firmware read these as compiled defaults; the serial CFG channel can override the page keys live.

brightness_probe.objective: predicted per-lamp burst amp headroom = P90 of lamp-core pixels (5x5 core max) minus local background ring median during the solid-ON probe — drive lamp cores to the JUST-BELOW-CLIP knee (saturated cores strangle amp; starved cores waste SNR)
brightness_probe.adjust: multiplicative L_new = L * targetP90 / measuredP90 (clamped to ±1.5x per step)
brightness_probe.telemetry: BSTATS per probe step {L, P90, clipPct, histMed} + final {bright, histMed, clipPct, probeIters}

corpus_calibration.note: all 14 S14R bursts overdrove: lamp-core clipPct 17.1-56.0% (bBurstB 150 fixed), coreP90 = 255 everywhere — the [235,250]/<=5% knee band is the calibrated NEW ground the probe aims at, not an observed-corpora regime; frame-p95 band 225-245 retained as the exposure-class sanity check

evidence.s14r-and-r5 (histMed 83.5): thr 93.5: 387->386 (hairline site 398 blur 100.9 amp 44.5 flips argmax; documented cost)

exposure.androidEvBiasNote: 03 Oct operator call: stays -1; the -3 intent never landed in a real burst (all 25 first-0002 readbacks ev=-1), all calibration corpora ran at -1, iOS ignores it
exposure.iosPoi: no evBias; POI tap + flash feedback + re-assert each burst

calBattery._readme: S14R-0003 autonomous CAL battery (page /cal, CAL directive): compiled defaults for the battery state machine. CALCFG=<json> overrides live per run (page merges; same key names). Labels: E1/E2/E3/E5 use cal:<exp>:…, E4 uses the UNTOUCHED survey run space cwc:rN:* so the console decoder (cwc_pos_decode.py) works byte-compat on those runs.

serve.transport: same TLS+wss as the survey page (shared /ws, JSON cmds + 246 B frame-bits)
serve.start: CAL serial directive (cmds file one-shot via bench daemon, like BURST)
serve.abort: ABRT directive (checked at every step boundary; rig returned to black)

calBattery.e2_duty_note: duty-0.5 paint = an exact coded plane's ON set: codeword ROW 'dutyBank' over the mapped codes (plane 0 = 300 of the first 600 lamps; bank is complementary-paired so every row is exactly 50%)
calBattery.e4_duty_note: E4 dwell paint uses the COMPLEMENT of codeword plane 0 (-1) = the exact inverse 50% coded pattern, contrasting each burst master; dwell 2000 ms probe-style, then ONE real 24-plane CWC burst at that L using the existing burst primitive (primer 1000 ms, cwcSettle planes, fast master) with survey labels cwc:rN:*

telemetry.per_step: CALSTATS {kind:'step', exp, stepIdx|jump, L, duty, snaps, histMed (CWCSTATS recipe parity), coreP90 (raw-core P90 over self-segmented bright blobs: threshold blobSegThr + 4-conn components, blobMinPx), blobs, nCores, expReadback}
telemetry.per_E4_run: CWCSTATS {mode:'calE4', L, n, rig, histMed(master), probeIters:0} + labels cwc:rN:p00..p23/master (console decoder compatible)
telemetry.battery: CALSTATS {kind:'battery', build, order, done, mins, rig, cwcN}
telemetry.frames: FRAME/FJPEG/FEND groups with per-frame label + ts + exp, same as the survey page
